main_text.p: מִקּק Ithpehal אִתְמְקַק Ch.Sternutare. Ithpahel prima radicali geminata אִתְמַקְמַק Debilitari, Infirmari, Genef.34.25. & Deut.31.18. in Jon.Item Liquefieri, Diffolvi,Pfal.73.8.
מָרָא, מַר, מָרִי Chald.& Syr.Dominus.Plural. מָרֵי, מָרֵי, מָרִין.Ex alia forma S. ܡܪܝ Duobus Dominis, Matt.6.24.& ܡܪܝܢ, ad Ephef. 6.9. 1.Pet.5.3.Fœm. מָרְתָא, מָרַת Domina, Hera.
מָרָן Ch. & Syr. Idem, Hinc ܡܪܢ ܐܬܐ, Maran atha, quo extrema anathematis fpecies defignatur, 1. ad Cor.16.22.Vide ibi notas Tremellii.
מָרוּרָא, מָרוֹרַי, מָרוּתָא, מָרוֹא Chald. Dominium, Dominatio, Dominatus. Plural. Syriac. ܡܪܘܬܐ, ad Coloff.1.16.
מְרָא Syr. Pahel Imitari, Æmulari, Unde ܡܪܥܝܢ Et imitamini fidem ipforum,ad Hebr.13.7.
מָרֵב Ch. Lapidis pretiofi nomen ; Quidam Onychinum exponunt,Cant.5.14.
מָרַנ Ch. Propellere, Impellere, 2.Sam.6.6. Ithpehal. אִתְמְרַנ Impelli, Deut.19.5.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; the Syriac and some pointed Hebrew forms are approximate. The catchword מרגנין is at the foot right.
